misconceptions.description: Presenting a wireframe as finished when its regions are not tied to learner actions or to a place in the instructional sequence
misconceptions.trigger: wireframe shows placement and styling but no annotation of which learner action each region supports
misconceptions.feedback: Annotate each region with the learner action it supports and where it sits in the sequence. Layout alone is not learning logic.

misconceptions.description: Adding final colors, copy, and pixel-exact sizing before the interaction and sequence are settled
misconceptions.trigger: wireframe specifies brand colors, final copy, or exact pixel widths during early review
misconceptions.feedback: Keep the wireframe low-fidelity so review stays on flow and learner action. Add visual fidelity after the learning logic is settled.

misconceptions.description: Accepting an AI-generated layout as if its interaction choices encode sound instructional decisions
misconceptions.trigger: learner keeps AI feedback timing or placement without checking it against the intended sequence
misconceptions.feedback: Treat the AI layout as a draft block. Move feedback, hints, and actions to where your learning sequence requires them.
